messages.text: In one sentence: what do you own for company success?

I own the TECH_STRATEGY.md document—which defines our technology stack, coding guidelines, and the tech radar—and I am responsible for enforcing these standards and making all final decisions on infrastructure and tool selection under the zero-cost mandate.
